QuestInfo.name: [Erel Light] The Important Questions
QuestInfo.0: #p9201713# isn't his usual self. Talk to him again.
QuestInfo.1: Is the barrier really just a blessing? #p9201713# said that sometimes he feels like it traps everyone inside. The same can be said about you. You've never considered breaking it...but #p9201713# seems convinced.
QuestInfo.2: You encountered monsters corrupted by darkness on your way back to Pente and defeated them. With the residents in peril, you knew you had to hurry.
